notes:
Summary: financial-services R&D org building an enterprise IDE copilot for internal engineers. Primary drivers: reduce mean-time-to-change, lower review cycles, and maintain audit trail for regulated deployments.

Highlights / quotes:
- 'We need the copilot to live inside our network boundary; no model data should leave our VPC.' - Tom Lin, Head of AI.
- Low-latency streaming is a hard requirement for inline completions in their custom IDE (target p50 < 40ms for token streaming in local network).
- Model/version pinning mandatory: compliance wants ability to freeze a model hash per release.

Requirements & constraints (shorthand):
- Deployment: private control plane + optional on-prem inference cluster. VPC peering or direct connect preferred.
- Auth: SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning.
- Audit: full token-level audit logs; immutable write-once storage for retention window (7 years discussed with compliance).
- KMS: customer-managed keys (HSM integration recommended).
- Data residency: core inference logs must remain in NA primary region; backups can be encrypted and stored per retention policy.
- Cost sensitivity: POC focused on latency & correctness; after POC procurement will evaluate Dedicated reservation vs Private license.

POC success criteria (customer):
- Achieve streaming p50 < 40ms in lab over VPC connection and p95 < 120ms for worst-case long prefix.
- Demonstrate model pinning + rollback across a dev->staging->prod rollout.
- Show audit log pipeline to their Splunk instance with correct token-level attribution.
- Provide draft security questionnaire answers and KMS proof-of-concept.

- Rafael to prepare infra checklist and sample deployment manifest by 2026-03-10.
- Maya to request SAML metadata and legal point of contact.
- SE + Infra sync to set up VPN/direct-connect options (blocked until CIDRs).
